summary: Visible fix: the SuggestionBar now shows nothing with suggestions.enabled: false (it used to show follow-up and static chips anyway), and a turn that brings no follow-ups no longer keeps showing the previous turn's chips; the static chips (or none) show instead.
howTo: Nothing to change if the bar should behave as configured. An app that set suggestions.enabled: false but relied on the chips showing anyway removes enabled: false. An app that relied on a turn's follow-ups staying visible after later turns keeps them itself (useSuggestions().chips, onTurnEnd) or sets staticChips as the fallback.
